	ContentType string

type BodyMeta struct {
	Required bool
	Schema   map[string]any
}

	Meta     `produces:"text/csv"`
	Filename string
	Header   []string
	Rows     func(yield func([]string) error) error
}
type ContextKey[T any] struct {
	name string
	id   *contextKeyID
}

	Validate(context.Context) error
}
type DocSet struct {
	Operations map[string]OperationDoc
	Fields     map[string]string
}
type FieldError struct {
	Location string `json:"location,omitempty"`
	Field    string `json:"field,omitempty"`
	Message  string `json:"message"`
}
type Group struct {
	router     *Router
	parent     *Group
	prefix     string
	middleware []Middleware
	tags       []string
	frozen     bool
}

	Status int
	Title  string
	Detail string
	Err    error
}
type Handler[In, Out any] func(context.Context, In) (Out, error)

	ResponseHeaders() http.Header
}
type Headers http.Header
type Meta struct{}
type Middleware func(http.Handler) http.Handler
type OperationDoc struct {
	Summary     string
	Description string
}
type OperationMeta struct {
	Method              string
	Path                string
	OperationID         string
	Summary             string
	Description         string
	Tags                []string
	RequiredPermissions []string
	Status              int
	NoContent           bool
	Hidden              bool
	Produces            []string
	Params              []ParamMeta
	Body                *BodyMeta
	ResponseSchema      map[string]any
	raw                 bool
	responder           bool
	inputType           reflect.Type
	defaults            []defaultCheck
}
type OpsConfig struct {
	LivePath    string
	ReadyPath   string
	OpenAPIPath string
	DocsPath    string

	DisableLive    bool
	DisableReady   bool
	DisableOpenAPI bool

	Checks  []ReadyCheck
	Timeout time.Duration
	Logger  *slog.Logger

	Live    http.HandlerFunc
	Ready   http.HandlerFunc
	OpenAPI http.HandlerFunc
	Docs    http.Handler
}
type OpsSettings struct {
	LivenessEnabled bool `env:"LIVENESS_ENABLED,default=true" envdoc:"Register the liveness endpoint."`

	LivenessPath string `env:"LIVENESS_PATH,default=/livez" envdoc:"Liveness endpoint path." validate:"startswith=/"`

	ReadinessEnabled bool `env:"READINESS_ENABLED,default=true" envdoc:"Register the readiness endpoint."`

	ReadinessPath string `env:"READINESS_PATH,default=/readyz" envdoc:"Readiness endpoint path." validate:"startswith=/"`

	OpenAPIEnabled bool `env:"OPENAPI_ENABLED,default=true" envdoc:"Register the OpenAPI document and Swagger UI."`

	OpenAPIPath string `env:"OPENAPI_PATH,default=/openapi.json" envdoc:"OpenAPI document path." validate:"startswith=/"`

	DocsPath string `env:"DOCS_PATH,default=/docs/" envdoc:"Swagger UI path; a trailing slash is added when omitted." validate:"startswith=/"`
}
type Option func(*OperationMeta)
type ParamMeta struct {
	Name        string
	In          string
	Required    bool
	Description string
	Schema      map[string]any
}
type PlainValidator interface {
	Validate() error
}
type Problem struct {
	Type     string       `json:"type,omitempty"`
	Title    string       `json:"title"`
	Status   int          `json:"status"`
	Detail   string       `json:"detail,omitempty"`
	Instance string       `json:"instance,omitempty"`
	Errors   []FieldError `json:"errors,omitempty"`
}
type ReadyCheck struct {
	Name  string
	Check func(context.Context) error
}
type ReadyConfig struct {
	Checks  []ReadyCheck
	Timeout time.Duration
	Logger  *slog.Logger
}
type Responder interface {
	Respond(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request) error
}
type Router struct {
	mux             *http.ServeMux
	logger          *slog.Logger
	title           string
	version         string
	validate        *validator.Validate
	validationTags  map[string]bool
	middleware      []Middleware
	ops             []OperationMeta
	docs            DocSet
	frozen          bool
	opsMu           sync.Mutex
	opsRevision     uint64
	openapiJSON     []byte
	openapiRevision uint64
}
type SSE struct {
	w          http.ResponseWriter
	controller *http.ResponseController
}
type StreamRegistry struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	next    uint64
	closed  bool
	closers map[uint64]func()
	logger  *slog.Logger
}
type ValidationError struct {
	Errors []FieldError
}

type AdminStore interface {
	ListFailed(context.Context, int, int) ([]Job, error)
	RetryFailed(context.Context, string) (Job, error)
	DeleteFailed(context.Context, string) error
}
type EnqueueOption func(*EnqueueOptions)
type EnqueueOptions struct {
	RunAt       time.Time
	MaxAttempts int
}
type Handler func(context.Context, json.RawMessage) error
type Job struct {
	ID string `json:"id"`

	Kind string `json:"kind"`

	Payload json.RawMessage `json:"payload"`

	Status string `json:"status"`

	RunAt time.Time `json:"run_at"`

	Attempts int `json:"attempts"`

	MaxAttempts int `json:"max_attempts"`

	LastError *string `json:"last_error,omitempty"`

	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`

	UpdatedAt time.Time `json:"updated_at"`

	LeaseToken string `json:"-"`
}
type Lease struct {
	JobID    string
	WorkerID string
	Attempt  int
	Token    string
}
type Observer struct {
	AttemptStarted func(context.Context, Job) context.Context

	AttemptFinished func(context.Context, Job, time.Duration, error)

	SchedulesDispatched func(context.Context, int, time.Duration, error)
}
type Registry struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	handlers map[string]registration
}
type Schedule struct {
	Name     string
	Kind     string
	Payload  any
	Interval time.Duration
}
type Scheduler struct {
	store     SchedulerStore
	logger    *slog.Logger
	cfg       SchedulerConfig
	schedules []Schedule
	registry  *Registry
	observer  Observer

	lifecycleMu sync.Mutex
	mu          sync.Mutex
	cancel      context.CancelFunc
	done        chan struct{}
	wg          sync.WaitGroup

	running     atomic.Bool
	failed      chan struct{}
	failureMu   sync.Mutex
	failureErr  error
	failureOnce sync.Once
}
type SchedulerConfig struct {
	Interval time.Duration `env:"INTERVAL,default=1s" envdoc:"Delay between due-schedule scans." validate:"gt=0"`

	Batch int `env:"BATCH,default=20" envdoc:"Maximum number of due schedules dispatched per scan." validate:"gte=1"`
}
type SchedulerOption func(*schedulerOptions)
type SchedulerStore interface {
	ReconcileSchedules(context.Context, []Schedule) error
	DispatchDueSchedules(context.Context, int) (int, error)
}
type Store interface {
	Enqueue(context.Context, string, any, ...EnqueueOption) (Job, error)
	Get(context.Context, string) (Job, error)
	ListFailed(context.Context, int, int) ([]Job, error)
	RetryFailed(context.Context, string) (Job, error)
	DeleteFailed(context.Context, string) error
	Claim(context.Context, string) (*Job, error)
	MarkSucceeded(context.Context, Lease) error
	MarkFailed(context.Context, Lease, error, time.Time) error
	MarkInterrupted(context.Context, Lease, error) error
	RecoverStale(context.Context, time.Duration) error
	DispatchDueSchedules(context.Context, int) (int, error)
	UpsertSchedule(context.Context, Schedule) error
	ReconcileSchedules(context.Context, []Schedule) error
	DisableSchedulesExcept(context.Context, []string) error
	Ping(context.Context) error
}
type Worker struct {
	store      WorkerStore
	registry   *Registry
	logger     *slog.Logger
	cfg        WorkerConfig
	instanceID string
	observer   Observer

	lifecycleMu sync.Mutex
	mu          sync.Mutex
	claimCtx    context.Context
	claim       context.CancelFunc
	jobCtx      context.Context
	job         context.CancelFunc
	done        chan struct{}
	wg          sync.WaitGroup

	running     atomic.Bool
	inFlight    atomic.Int64
	failed      chan struct{}
	failureMu   sync.Mutex
	failureErr  error
	failureOnce sync.Once
}
type WorkerConfig struct {
	Concurrency int `env:"CONCURRENCY,default=4" envdoc:"Number of jobs claimed concurrently." validate:"gte=1"`

	PollInterval time.Duration `env:"POLL_INTERVAL,default=500ms" envdoc:"Delay between empty queue polls." validate:"gt=0"`

	JobTimeout time.Duration `env:"TIMEOUT,default=30s" envdoc:"Maximum duration of one job attempt." validate:"gt=0"`

	StaleAfter time.Duration `env:"STALE_AFTER,default=2m" envdoc:"Age after which an abandoned running job is returned to the queue." validate:"gtfield=JobTimeout"`

	RetryBase time.Duration `env:"RETRY_BASE,default=1s" envdoc:"Initial retry delay." validate:"gt=0"`

	RetryMax time.Duration `env:"RETRY_MAX,default=1m" envdoc:"Maximum retry delay." validate:"gtefield=RetryBase"`
}
type WorkerOption func(*workerOptions)
type WorkerStore interface {
	Claim(context.Context, string) (*Job, error)
	MarkSucceeded(context.Context, Lease) error
	MarkFailed(context.Context, Lease, error, time.Time) error
	MarkInterrupted(context.Context, Lease, error) error
	RecoverStale(context.Context, time.Duration) error
}

	Leeway     time.Duration
}
type Verifier struct {
	key        any
	algorithms []string
	issuer     string
	audience   []string
	leeway     time.Duration
}

package github.com/plinth-go/plinth/platform/objectstore
func NormalizeKey(key string) (string, error)
func NormalizePrefix(prefix string) (string, error)
type Object struct {
	Key         string
	Size        int64
	ContentType string
	ModifiedAt  time.Time
}
type PutOptions struct {
	ContentType  string
	CacheControl string
	Metadata     map[string]string
}
type Store interface {
	Put(context.Context, string, io.Reader, int64, PutOptions) (Object, error)
	Open(context.Context, string) (io.ReadCloser, Object, error)
	Stat(context.Context, string) (Object, error)
	Delete(context.Context, string) error
	List(context.Context, string, int) ([]Object, error)
}
var ErrNotFound = errors.New("object not found")

func (s *Store) Put(ctx context.Context, key string, body io.Reader, size int64, opts objectstore.PutOptions) (objectstore.Object, error)
func (s *Store) Stat(ctx context.Context, key string) (objectstore.Object, error)
func New(root string) (*Store, error)
type Store struct {
	root string
}

package github.com/plinth-go/plinth/platform/objectstore/s3store
func (s *Store) Delete(ctx context.Context, key string) error
func (s *Store) List(ctx context.Context, prefix string, limit int) ([]objectstore.Object, error)
func (s *Store) Open(ctx context.Context, key string) (io.ReadCloser, objectstore.Object, error)
func (s *Store) Put(ctx context.Context, key string, source io.Reader, size int64, opts objectstore.PutOptions) (objectstore.Object, error)
func (s *Store) Stat(ctx context.Context, key string) (objectstore.Object, error)
func New(client API, cfg Config) (*Store, error)
type API interface {
	PutObject(context.Context, *s3.PutObjectInput, ...func(*s3.Options)) (*s3.PutObjectOutput, error)
	GetObject(context.Context, *s3.GetObjectInput, ...func(*s3.Options)) (*s3.GetObjectOutput, error)
	HeadObject(context.Context, *s3.HeadObjectInput, ...func(*s3.Options)) (*s3.HeadObjectOutput, error)
	DeleteObject(context.Context, *s3.DeleteObjectInput, ...func(*s3.Options)) (*s3.DeleteObjectOutput, error)
	ListObjectsV2(context.Context, *s3.ListObjectsV2Input, ...func(*s3.Options)) (*s3.ListObjectsV2Output, error)
}
type Config struct {
	Bucket string

	Prefix string
}
type Store struct {
	client API
	bucket string
	prefix string
}

package github.com/plinth-go/plinth/runtime
func (h *HTTP) Failed() <-chan struct{}
func (h *HTTP) Failure() error
func (h *HTTP) Name() string
func (h *HTTP) Start(ctx context.Context) error
func (h *HTTP) Stop(ctx context.Context) error
func (r *Runtime) Add(components ...Component)
func (r *Runtime) Run(ctx context.Context) error
func DefaultHTTPConfig() HTTPConfig
func New(logger *slog.Logger, timeout time.Duration) *Runtime
func NewHTTP(addr string, handler http.Handler, streams StreamCloser, logger *slog.Logger, options ...HTTPOption) *HTTP
func WithHTTPConfig(config HTTPConfig) HTTPOption
type Component interface {
	Name() string
	Start(context.Context) error
	Stop(context.Context) error
}
type FailureReporter interface {
	Failed() <-chan struct{}
	Failure() error
}
type HTTP struct {
	addr    string
	handler http.Handler
	logger  *slog.Logger
	streams StreamCloser
	config  httpServerSettings

	mu         sync.Mutex
	srv        *http.Server
	listener   net.Listener
	baseCancel context.CancelFunc
	failed     chan struct{}
	serveErr   error
	closed     bool
}
type HTTPConfig struct {
	ReadHeaderTimeout time.Duration

	ReadTimeout time.Duration

	IdleTimeout time.Duration

	MaxHeaderBytes int

	TLSCertFile string
	TLSKeyFile  string

	TLSConfig *tls.Config

	EnableHTTP2 bool

	Protocols *http.Protocols

	Listen func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Listener, error)

	ConfigureServer func(*http.Server) error
}
type HTTPOption func(*httpServerSettings)
type Runtime struct {
	logger     *slog.Logger
	timeout    time.Duration
	components []Component

	mu      sync.Mutex
	running bool
	ran     bool
}
type StreamCloser interface {
	CloseStreams()
}
